heading: Records of certification
lead: The Secretary shall keep records of certificates of inspection of vessels and of all acts in the examination and inspection of vessels, whether of approval or disapproval.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 331046:414 Section 3310 contains the requirement for maintaining inspection records.
Effective DateSection effective Apr. 15, 1984, see section 2(g)(1) of Pub. L. 98–89, set out as a note under section 3101 of this title.
